verdict.rationale: Clerk documents Organizations for multi-tenant B2B grouping (clerk-docs-3, clerk-docs-31, clerk-docs-24) and separately documents Enterprise SSO via SAML/OIDC with IdP data sync (clerk-docs-8, clerk-docs-28), which implies JIT provisioning of synced user data. However, the evidence never explicitly ties Enterprise SSO connections to individual organizations, nor documents a 'verified domain' feature for scoping which org an SSO connection belongs to — the two capabilities are described as separate product areas rather than an integrated per-tenant SSO workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domain verification per organization, explicit binding of an SSO connection to a specific Organization entity, and confirmation that provisioning happens just-in-time into the correct org context.
